fields.reason_for_admission: End-stage osteoarthritis of the right knee after failed conservative treatment, needing joint replacement
fields.condition_at_discharge: Walking with a walker, wound healthy

narrative: The patient was admitted for end-stage osteoarthritis of the right knee following failed conservative treatment. A right total knee replacement was performed to alleviate symptoms and improve mobility. The patient's condition improved postoperatively, and he was discharged on day four walking with a walker and with a healthy surgical wound.
